main.description: Record representing the team for one domain. The record key is the domain name, created lazily with the first accepted membership.

createdAt.description: When the team record was created.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name this team applies to, e.g. example.com.

subject.description: Strong reference to the owner's at.marque.domain record.

updatedAt.description: When the team record was last updated.

description: A team for a single domain managed by Marque, owned by the domain owner. Stored in the owner's repository.
